defects.description: The translation incorrectly attributes the method name. It suggests that 'Документатор' is the name of the method, whereas 'audit' is the method and 'Documenter' is the object/class it belongs to.
Gender agreement error: 'граница' is feminine, so it should be 'на каждой границе' instead of 'на каждом границе'.
Missing preposition 'об' (about/of), resulting in an ungrammatical phrase.
